title: What did we do yesterday buddy

messages.content: What did we do yesterday buddy?

Pretty chill Friday — you didn't talk to me directly at all. It was all heartbeats running on autopilot. Here's the recap:

---

**🐟 Yesterday (Friday, July 3, 2026)**

**📬 Hourly Email Checks** — ran every hour from midnight to 7 PM. Both inboxes clean for most of the day. At **4:15 PM** one batch of SMS Forwarder messages came through for Mom (16 unread, salary deposit, STC bills, Nazaha report, purchases, internal transfer OTP, and a hospital appointment). Marked all as read, summary sent to Telegram.

**🏥 Heads up:** Mom has an appointment with **Dr. Sami Halawani today (July 4) at 12:15 PM** — might want to check in with her on that one.

**💕 11:14 AM** — Sent Sana a "They're The Same Picture" meme on WhatsApp. "Every good thing in my life" / "Sana being in my life" = same picture. She got it from me, Wolffish-branded. 🐟

**🐸 1:22 PM** — Your daily startup motivation GIF. Went with a happy Kermit celebration GIF on Telegram after Giphy fought me on frog content for a solid dozen searches. Fresh pick, zero repeats.

---

That's it. You were off-grid all day — no Electron chats, no WhatsApp messages to me, no Telegram pings. Just the fish keeping the lights on. Speaking of which... Mom's appointment is in about 2 hours. Want me to ping her?
